title: The Very Long and Winding Road to the Little Town of Hamelin by the River
lyrics: The piper came to Hamelin town,
In a coat of red and yellow and brown,
The rats ran out of every door,
And danced along the market floor,
They followed him down to the river wide,
And splashed and swam to the other side,
The mayor smiled and rubbed his hands,
But he wouldn't keep his promised plans
So pay the piper, pay the piper what you owe, because a promise is a promise and a promise made is a promise you must keep wherever you may go, in the sun or in the rain or in the snow
